setup.note: BatchPIRServer construction: synthetic database generation, simple/cuckoo hashing into buckets, and NTT preprocessing of the PIR database. Measured once (client key generation not separately timed).

client_offline_download.note: No separate client offline-download phase: the bucket hash-map and Galois/relin keys are exchanged in-process and are not independently timed by the binary.

query_generation.note: create_queries: cuckoo hashing of the requested batch plus BFV encryption of the per-bucket query vectors.

server_answer.note: generate_response over the encrypted batch query; headline metric. Trials re-run on identical queries after a single setup.

client_extract.note: decode_responses_chunks: decryption and extraction of all batch entries from the server response.

lattice_dimension.note: Not exposed by the binary. The BFV ring dimension is compiled in (DatabaseConstants::PolyDegree = 8192). No flag changes it, so lattice_dimension is logged and dropped, never forwarded.

notes: mode=batch: retrieving batch_size=4 records per query.
Scheme-reported total serialized communication (query+response): 642 KB (~657408 bytes). Reported here split into query_upload_bytes and response_bytes measured directly via save_size().
Decoded batch entries verified against the server database.
FHE parameter-table selection string: '4,16384,256'. Known-good combos: 32/64/256 x 1048576 x 32, and 256 x {10485,104857} x {32,256}; other inputs fall back to default SEAL parameters.
Built for AVX2 (x86-64-v3); does NOT require AVX-512. Apple-Silicon-via-Rosetta timings are for pipeline validation only — collect publication numbers on native x86-64.
